prompt:
In packages/agent-scheduler/src/run.LOGIC.md, the section 'The checkout' says that when a run names a follow-up its checkout is 'put under the hold [12]' and that a hold that cannot be put fails the run with 'could not hold the merge'. The code has no such hold: run.ts only adds the line HOLD_MERGE_LINE to the agent's prompt (described under 'The follow-up'), and glossary item [12] is the git host. Remove those sentences from 'The checkout' so the file says what the code does, and change nothing else. Commit, push your branch and open its pull request.

Open the pull request but do not arm its merge: it is merged for you once a follow-up is done.

text:
I removed the made-up merge hold from the checkout section of `packages/agent-scheduler/src/run.LOGIC.md`. That section now says only what the code does.

The one deleted passage is the claim that a run with a follow-up puts its checkout under "the hold [12]", and fails with `could not hold the merge` when it can't. Nothing else in the file changed. The line the code really adds to the agent's prompt (`HOLD_MERGE_LINE`) was already described under "The follow-up", so nothing needed adding.

I committed the change, pushed the branch and opened the pull request: https://github.com/framework/the-framework/pull/1841. Its merge is not armed; it will be merged once the follow-up is done.
